name: Rogers Red World Elite Mastercard

apr.notes: Standard rate 21.99% to 25.99% on purchases and fees; 22.99% to 27.99% on cash advances, cash-like transactions and balance transfers.

credit_required.notes: Minimum $80,000 personal or $150,000 household annual income.

base_rate.description: 1.5% cash back on eligible purchases; 2% with at least one qualifying Rogers, Fido, Shaw or Comwave service.

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back redeems at 1.5 times its regular value against eligible Rogers purchases online and at participating Rogers and Fido stores.

notes: Network tier is World Elite Mastercard per the card name.
